description: PC4: solves the overlap-engagement race analytically. Phase 1 of the pair-collision model integrates exactly (d^2 linear in t; V1 ~ (1-u)^{-1/2}), giving engagement at u = 1-(V1_0/d0^2)^{2/3} < 1 STRICTLY for every positive initial core size — verified against the ODE to <1e-3 across 7 decades. Within the two-regime corpus model the sharpened question of qns-pair-riccati-probe is DECIDED: the hyperbolic-overlap saturation always engages before the singular time; the pair channel is regular (branch B) for every positive core; only the measure-zero point-vortex limit reaches t*. Scope (a): model-level — whether the two-regime model is uniformly valid at the PDE level is the remaining open question. Consistent with lock-scaling (beta~1) and the sustained-forcing picture. Exploratory tier.

data.finding: Race DECIDED in-model: u_overlap = 1-(V1_0/d0^2)^(2/3) < 1 always; pair channel branch B for every positive core size. Scope (a).
